chunks: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Al-Hasan b. Ali al-Sukkari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya al-Basri narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. 'Ammara narrated to us from his father, from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon them both). He said:

Indeed, earthquakes, the two eclipses, and tremendous winds are among the signs of the Hour. So when you see something of that, then remember the coming of the Day of Resurrection and hurry to your mosques.

key_terms.علامات الساعة: Signs of the Hour, indicators of the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the Day of Judgment according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS), through his son Imam al-Sadiq (AS), teaches that natural calamities such as earthquakes, solar and lunar eclipses, and severe storms are among the eschatological signs of the Hour. The faithful are instructed to respond to these events by remembering the Day of Resurrection and seeking refuge in mosques through prayer, rather than panicking. This hadith was delivered in al-Saduq's assembly on the last Friday of Jumada al-Ula, 368 AH.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Hasan b. `Ali al-Sikri narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya al-Basri narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Ammara narrated to us from his father from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father (as). He said:
Surely, earthquakes, eclipses, and tremendous winds are among the signs of the Hour. When you see something of that, then remember the Day of Resurrection and hurry to your mosques.
